bug.title: Spot the bug · sumTo
bug.prompt: sumTo(4) should give 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10, but it gives 6. Click the line with the bug.

code.title: Code bench · isEven
code.prompt: Write isEven(n): true when n is even, false when it is odd.

pair.title: In pairs · explain the bug
pair.prompt: With your partner: why does `i < n` give the wrong sum, and how would you fix it?
rubric: Says the loop stops before the last number
Gives a fix that includes n (i <= n, or n + 1)
pair.example: The loop stops when i reaches n, so n itself is never added. Changing the test to i <= n includes it.

poll.title: Poll · how was that?
poll.prompt: How did this lesson go for you?

trophies.name: Off by one
trophies.text: A loop that stops one step early or late is one of the most common bugs. Check its first and its last round.
trophies.example: i < n stops before n; i <= n includes it.

trophies.name: It runs
trophies.text: A check is a small question your code must answer correctly. Write the check first, then the code.
